description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'DistributedData' that serves as a base for managing distributed data objects using Akka's clustering and data replication features. It includes methods for creating configuration, managing the lifecycle of the replicated data, and subscribing to data changes. The class is generic over the type of replicated data and integrates with Akka's actor system and replication mechanisms.

classes.name: DistributedData
classes.description: Abstract base class managing distributed data objects with Akka clustering, providing core functionalities for creation, retrieval, updating, and subscription to data changes.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Creates a DistributedDataConfig with default Akka settings, specified by replicator name and cluster role.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current state of the distributed data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous update operation on the distributed data, applying the provided update function.

methods.name: subscribeForChanges
methods.description: Subscribes an actor to be notified of changes to the distributed data.
